name: Startup Folder Shortcut / Executable Dropped
description: Detects a new executable or shortcut (.lnk, .exe, .bat) created in user or system Startup folders.
explanation: Dropping shortcuts into the Startup folder ensures payload execution upon next user logon without requiring registry manipulation.
investigation_steps: Inspect shortcut target path and argument list.
Check creation timestamp and identify the creator process.
Verify whether the file was placed by legitimate application installer.
